g.text: Cloud agent bootstrap - two providers, one script
Both cloud entry points end at the same provider-agnostic script, so Cursor and Claude Code VMs provision identically.
runs synchronously - the session waits, so
no task can race a half-installed VM
Cursor's install command takes an arbitrary path, so it runs ai-coding/hooks/cloud-agent-bootstrap.sh straight from the source tree
and needs no mirror. Claude Code discovers hooks by path inside .claude/, so make mirrors copies the adapter to .claude/hooks/ and
settings.json invokes that copy; the adapter then execs the bootstrap sitting beside it.
Guard: session-start.sh exits 0 unless CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true, so a local Claude Code session on an already-provisioned machine
never apt-installs behind the developer's back; ./install.sh stays in charge there.
